reason: Touches core statistics/planner paths and changes pseudo-stats construction/representation in `table.go`, `histogram.go`, `handle.go`, plus `planbuilder.go`. Even though framed as a memory optimization, pseudo stats are a broad fallback used when real stats are missing, so mistakes can alter cardinality/cost behavior across many queries or introduce shared-state/runtime correctness issues. This is central enough and high-blast-radius enough to justify a deeper Blocker/High-focused review.
